usedFor: StatusCake watches websites, and “Create Uptime Check” and “Create SSL Check” set up what it monitors.

bestTemplate.name: “Receive Incoming Message” in Quo, then “Create Page Speed Test” in StatusCake
bestTemplate.why: It sets up a recurring page speed check for a website URL.

watchOut: Each check runs at the interval you choose, so pick one that suits the site.
